snippet.title: CitaDrill - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase
snippet.description:
Captain a giant drill in this basebuilder roguelite with a combination of action and strategy! Build, explore, and survive in a world inspired by 1-bit aesthetics. Who will win: the abyss and its fearsome tests, or your mettle and paw-some cat crew?
